lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Come on. One clean page. That is all I am asking for.

lines.speaker: The Page
lines.text: No work. No judgment. No consequences.

lines.speaker: The Page
lines.text: Everything you want. Forever.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: That seems like a very responsible thing to click.

lines.speaker: Pyrra
lines.text: A living human.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Usually people lead with hello.

lines.speaker: Pyrra
lines.text: You are available. The Seven Lords have sealed the way home. Break their claims and you may reach it.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: And the glowing hand?

lines.speaker: Pyrra
lines.text: Arcane Magic. Try not to point it at anything you cannot afford to replace.

lines.speaker: Belladonna
lines.text: Welcome, Milo. First night is free.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Knew Hell had better customer service.

lines.speaker: Pyrra
lines.text: Look closer. Nothing here is free.

lines.speaker: Maris
lines.text: You smell like smoke.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: That narrows it down surprisingly little.

lines.speaker: Maris
lines.text: Break the seal. I can help you survive what comes after.

lines.speaker: Gaia
lines.text: This is the champion Pyrra chose?

lines.speaker: Pyrra
lines.text: Chose implies options.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I am feeling extremely supported.

lines.speaker: Zephyra
lines.text: You jumped into Hell voluntarily?

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Finally, someone appreciates initiative.

lines.speaker: Zephyra
lines.text: Open this cage and I will make sure you keep moving.

lines.speaker: Bottomless Bartender
lines.text: Last call.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I just got here.

lines.speaker: Belladonna
lines.text: You can stay. Never hungry. Never lonely. Never bored. Never sober.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: The sales pitch gets worse every sentence.

lines.speaker: Belladonna
lines.text: Happiness ends. Appetite does not.

lines.speaker: Belladonna
lines.text: Lilith will devour you. She already prepared your room.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Prepared?

lines.speaker: Belladonna
lines.text: She knew you were coming.

lines.speaker: Pyrra
lines.text: We leave. Now.

lines.speaker: The Crowd
lines.text: MILO! MILO! MILO!

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: This place understands me.

lines.speaker: Maris
lines.text: They have been chanting for three hundred years.

lines.speaker: Nerissa
lines.text: Tonight, every heart belongs to Milo.

lines.speaker: Flora
lines.text: She made an entire kingdom adore her and she is still insecure.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: That does sound exhausting.

lines.speaker: Voltara
lines.text: Her concert is drawing power at twelve times sustainable output.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I like her less now that math is involved.

lines.speaker: Fan Club Champion
lines.text: We love you, Milo!

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: That somehow makes this worse.

lines.speaker: Nerissa
lines.text: No one will ignore you. No one will criticize you. No one will leave.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Do any of them know anything about me?

lines.speaker: Nerissa
lines.text: They know you deserve worship.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: That is flattering. Also not an answer.

lines.speaker: The Crowd
lines.text: Who is that?

lines.speaker: Nerissa
lines.text: Hurts, doesn’t it?

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: A normal amount.

lines.speaker: Pyrra
lines.text: You are visibly devastated.

lines.speaker: Maris
lines.text: Milo… there is someone shaped like you beneath the water.

lines.speaker: Roxyne
lines.text: Run.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: That is usually the plan.

lines.speaker: Crya
lines.text: She does not chase prey. She edits the forest until escape becomes a lie.

lines.speaker: Crya
lines.text: Break the seal. I can freeze her snares, but I cannot promise warmth.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Warmth has been oversold lately.

lines.speaker: Crya
lines.text: It cannot be wounded while it runs. Corner it at the marked choke points.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Finally, prey with project management.

lines.speaker: Roxyne
lines.text: You crossed two kingdoms and still mistake motion for progress.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I also mistake spite for motivation. It has worked so far.

lines.speaker: Roxyne
lines.text: Go on. Chase the version of yourself you wish you were.

lines.speaker: Roxyne
lines.text: Your shadow stopped running before you did.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: The thing beneath the water?

lines.speaker: Crya
lines.text: It knows you are coming now.

lines.speaker: Calyptra
lines.text: Every danger is posted. Every reward is real. Losing is still your decision.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Finally, a casino with an ethics department.

lines.speaker: Luna
lines.text: Read the table before you touch the chips. The House adores confidence.

lines.speaker: Lady Luckless
lines.text: Rule one: red cards rush. Rule two arrives when you earn it.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Weaponized terms and conditions. Great.

lines.speaker: Calyptra
lines.text: You do not hate chance, Milo. You hate knowing the choice was yours.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I can hate two things. I contain multitudes.

lines.speaker: Calyptra
lines.text: Then place every one of them on the table.

lines.speaker: Calyptra
lines.text: You won. Do not insult yourself by calling it luck.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I made choices while terrified. That counts?

lines.speaker: Luna
lines.text: That is when choices count most.

lines.speaker: Isolde
lines.text: Nothing rots here. Nothing leaves. Nothing has to become unfamiliar.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: That sounded comforting until the third sentence.

lines.speaker: Solara
lines.text: Warmth changes things. That is why she fears it.

lines.speaker: Memory Golem
lines.text: FIRST IMPACT RECORDED. SECOND IMPACT SCHEDULED.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: A calendar invite would have been fine.

lines.speaker: Isolde
lines.text: Stay. I will keep the version of you that still believes he can fix everything.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: He sounds exhausting. You can have the photograph.

lines.speaker: Isolde
lines.text: I do not preserve photographs. I preserve exits.

lines.speaker: Isolde
lines.text: If it changes, you may lose it.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: If it never changes, I never really had it.

lines.speaker: Solara
lines.text: Leave the door open. Let the air decide the rest.

lines.speaker: Somnia
lines.text: Your room is ready. No calls. No deadlines. No morning.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Can I see the cancellation policy?

lines.speaker: Aurelia
lines.text: Every door returns here. Keep track of what repeats.

lines.speaker: Dream Girl
lines.text: I can be whatever makes you stop looking for the door.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: That is romantic in a hostage-situation way.

lines.speaker: Aurelia
lines.text: Four anchors hold the fantasy. Break those, not the promise.

lines.speaker: Somnia
lines.text: You could wake to the same mess. Or sleep until it stops belonging to you.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: That is not how mess works. I have conducted research.

lines.speaker: Somnia
lines.text: Then dream of someone who cleans.

lines.speaker: Somnia
lines.text: The door will still be here when you are tired again.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Probably. I still have to be the one who opens it.

lines.speaker: Aurelia
lines.text: Then take the key. Do not give it the steering wheel.

lines.speaker: Vespera
lines.text: Every window shows the Milo people would have preferred.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Do any show one with health insurance?

lines.speaker: Noctissa
lines.text: Watch the broken edge. Reflections lie symmetrically.

lines.speaker: Better Milo
lines.text: I use the same tools. I simply do not waste them.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: You also talk like a productivity app. Advantage: me.

lines.speaker: Vespera
lines.text: Choose a face. I can make everyone agree it was always yours.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I barely maintain this one. I am not adding subscriptions.

lines.speaker: Vespera
lines.text: Then shatter with it.

lines.speaker: Vespera
lines.text: They will still compare you.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: They can form a committee. I am busy.

lines.speaker: Noctissa
lines.text: Good. Lilith hates arriving second to self-respect.

lines.speaker: Lilith
lines.text: Nine doors ago, I prepared a place for you. You took the scenic route.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I stopped for several life-altering arguments. Parking was terrible.

lines.speaker: Lilith
lines.text: Kneel. I will call the delay character development.

lines.speaker: Lilith’s Daughters
lines.text: ATTACK. DEFEND. MOVE. SPEND. THE QUEEN PROVIDES YOUR ROLE.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I have always tested poorly in group projects.

lines.speaker: Lilith
lines.text: Every lord offered a softer cage. I offer the throne beside mine.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Does it come with responsibilities? That feels like a trap.

lines.speaker: Lilith
lines.text: It comes with permission to stop apologizing for what you want.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I need better wants. Not permission.

lines.speaker: Lilith
lines.text: You think refusing me makes you free?

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: No. It makes the next mistake mine.

lines.speaker: Lilith
lines.text: Then meet the mistake that has been waiting underneath you.

lines.speaker: The Hollow
lines.text: You brought everyone. You always bring everyone when you do not want to be alone with me.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: I brought firepower. The emotional support is incidental.

lines.speaker: Seraphine
lines.text: It knows every borrowed voice. Save one that is yours.

lines.speaker: Boss Rush Herald
lines.text: SEVEN CLAIMS RECORDED. SEVEN REFUSALS REHEARSED.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Good. I hate learning new material under pressure.

lines.speaker: The Hollow
lines.text: First I will be everything you collected. Then everything you are without it.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: And after that?

lines.speaker: The Hollow
lines.text: After that, you stop pretending I am the enemy.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: You are not the part I have to kill. You are the part I have to stop abandoning.

lines.speaker: The Hollow
lines.text: The room will still be messy.

lines.speaker: Milo
lines.text: Yeah. I think I will clean one corner.

lines.speaker: Seraphine
lines.text: Morning, then. Bring everyone.
